system.description:
CONCENTRATE FOCUS SPIRIT
Action 1 AP
Duration 1 minute
You allow your Spirit Guide to manifest more completely around and through you.
The manifestation may appear as spectral figures, animal features, swirling leaves, elemental light, ancestral voices or another effect appropriate to your guide.
You gain the Manifestation ability associated with your Spirit Guide for the duration.
You may dismiss the manifestation as a Free (0 AP) action.

Use: spends 1 AP and the Focus use and puts your guide's one-minute manifestation on your sheet as an effect; Use again to dismiss it early.
